title: (RHSA-2020:1485) Moderate: OpenShift Container Platform 4.3.13 runc security update
portal_summary:
An update for runc is now available for Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 4.3.

Red Hat Product Security has rated this update as having a security impact of Moderate. A Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) base score, which gives a detailed severity rating, is available for each vulnerability from the CVE link(s) in the References section.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|4.3|x86_64
portal_description:
The runC tool is a lightweight, portable implementation of the Open Container Format (OCF) that provides container runtime.

Security Fix(es):

* runc: volume mount race condition with shared mounts led to information leak and integrity manipulation (CVE-2019-19921)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
